title: Natural variation in OsMYB305 downregulating cytokinin-mediated inhibition of leaf senescence contributes to regional adaptation in rice.
authors: Kim, Boyeong; Kim, Jinah; Shim, Yejin; Kang, Jinku; Yoon, Hyeryung; Cho, Sung-Hwan; Paek, Nam-Chon; Kang, Kiyoon
one_liner_zh: 该文研究水稻MYB转录因子OsMYB305通过直接结合OsIPT8和OsCKX2启动子调控细胞分裂素稳态进而影响叶片衰老，虽涉及TF-DNA结合与AlphaFold预测，但核心是植物生理表型与自然变异，互作机制深度有限，方法上仅用AlphaFold辅助预测，缺乏系统AI/物理模拟建模，属于广义TF-DNA互作且方法可借鉴的中档文献。
abstract: Accumulating evidence has identified transcription factors (TFs) as key regulators of the onset and progression of leaf senescence. However, the regulatory role of the rice myeloblastosis (MYB) TF OsMYB305 in this process remains largely unknown. CRISPR/Cas9-mediated osmyb305 knockout mutants were used to examine senescence phenotypes. Protein-DNA interactions were analyzed using in vivo and in vitro binding assays and predicted using AlphaFold. Natural variations in OsMYB305 were investigated using the International Rice Genebank Collection Information System database. osmyb305 mutants exhibited delayed leaf senescence under both natural and dark-induced senescence conditions. OsMYB305 TF downregulated adenosine phosphate-isopentenyltransferase 8 (OsIPT8) and upregulated cytokinin oxidase/dehydrogenase 2 (OsCKX2) by directly binding to their promoters, thereby modulating cytokinin homeostasis during leaf senescence. Natural single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in OsMYB305 were associated with phenotypic variation in leaf senescence among 3000 rice accessions, and a SNP in the cis-element of OsIPT8 promoter disrupted OsMYB305 binding affinity. These results identify OsMYB305 as a key transcriptional activator inducing leaf senescence and suggest that natural allelic variation in OsMYB305 contributes to regional adaptation in rice cultivation.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，转录因子（TFs）是叶片衰老起始和进程的关键调控因子。然而，水稻成髓细胞增生症（MYB）转录因子OsMYB305在此过程中的调控作用仍 largely 未知。通过CRISPR/Cas9介导的osmyb305敲除突变体用于检查衰老表型。利用体内和体外结合实验分析蛋白质-DNA相互作用，并使用AlphaFold进行预测。利用国际水稻基因库收集信息系统数据库调查OsMYB305的自然变异。osmyb305突变体在自然衰老和暗诱导衰老条件下均表现出延迟的叶片衰老。OsMYB305转录因子通过直接结合其启动子下调腺苷磷酸-异戊烯基转移酶8（OsIPT8）并上调细胞分裂素氧化酶/脱氢酶2（OsCKX2），从而在叶片衰老过程中调节细胞分裂素稳态。OsMYB305中的自然单核苷酸多态性（SNPs）与3000份水稻种质中叶片衰老的表型变异相关，且OsIPT8启动子顺式元件中的一个SNP破坏了OsMYB305的结合亲和力。这些结果将OsMYB305鉴定为诱导叶片衰老的关键转录激活因子，并表明OsMYB305的自然等位变异有助于水稻栽培的区域适应性。
